title: Studio Access pillar: the permission matrix draws some object grants differently from what the runtime enforces (detail withheld pending maintainer)
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named. Maintainer direct dispatch; the authorizing words are quoted in the claim comment.

## Summary

In Studio › Access, the permission matrix (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`) draws certain object grants of a permission set differently from what the runtime enforces for that set. An admin editing from the screen can change effective access without seeing it.

- Found by the implementer of #26597 (same family: the Studio Access matrix drawing a grant differently from the runtime). Measured once with a failing jsdom probe against the real editor page; the runtime side was read in code.
- The symptoms, the reproduction and the code location are **withheld pending maintainer**, per the maintainer's instruction for security defects that are not to be disclosed. The implementer receives them privately.

## Acceptance (public part)

- For every object grant shape the runtime honours, the matrix shows exactly what the runtime enforces.
- No click writes a change to effective access that the admin did not see on screen.
- A pin covers the case on the display side.

## Filing facts

- Business reason: admins decide object access from this screen; it must state the effective grant truthfully.
- Reader who acts: an `os-dev` implementer, dispatched directly by this PM session (`domain:ui`).
- Dedupe: semantic search `permission matrix wildcard object row Studio Access unticked clone permission set` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 11 hits; none about this display (nearest: #26597, the field-row sibling; closed #26187 readScope column).
- Source: out-of-scope finding of the #26597 implementer (PR #27006), 2026-10-28, session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`.
